'''Passel Argente's starship''' was the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] used this [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to travel to a rendezvous with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] scavenger, [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], aboard his freighter, the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']].<ref name="TCW-D" /> Later in the war, he traveled to the city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] where he was storing spoils of war, leaving them in the care of a corpulent [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Artruk]].<ref name="TCW-C">''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]''</ref>
